fuxiFmt.config.description: Explicit override, merged last. The individual fuxiFmt.* settings sit below the project fuxi-fmt.json; this sits above it, so a personal preference can beat a committed file on purpose.
fuxiFmt.blankLines.aroundBlocks.enum.0: Separate blocks by exactly one blank line.
fuxiFmt.blankLines.aroundBlocks.enum.1: Separate blocks by at least one blank line.
fuxiFmt.blankLines.maxConsecutive.descri: Cap on consecutive blank lines. `null` means unbounded, which is what makes `atLeast` meaningful (BLK-02).
fuxiFmt.blankLines.insideLists.descripti: Blank lines between list items. A blank line decides whether a list renders tight or loose, so the choice is explicit (BLK-03).
fuxiFmt.blankLines.insideLists.enum.0: Remove the blank, making the list tight.
fuxiFmt.blankLines.insideLists.enum.1: Keep exactly one blank, making the list loose.
fuxiFmt.blankLines.insideLists.enum.2: Leave the author's blank lines alone.
fuxiFmt.blankLines.insideBlockquotes.des: The blank lines at the head and tail of a block quote's own content. A quote's inside is a document of its own and its blank lines are written with its marker, so this decides whether the outermost ones stay (BLK-14).
fuxiFmt.blankLines.insideBlockquotes.enu: Drop the blank lines at the head and tail of the quote's content.
Keep them where the author wrote them.
fuxiFmt.table.mode.description: Pad table cells so the columns line up, or leave the author's layout alone (TBL-01).
fuxiFmt.table.mode.enum.0: Leave every table exactly as written.
fuxiFmt.table.mode.enum.1: Pad the cells and fill the delimiter row to the column width.
fuxiFmt.table.maxWidth.description: A row whose padded line would be wider than this is left as written, so a few long rows cannot stretch the rest (TBL-01). null means no cap.
fuxiFmt.table.cjkWidth.description: Columns a wide character occupies in your font: 2 for a fixed-pitch font whose CJK glyphs are two Latin advances, 1 for a proportional one (TBL-01).
fuxiFmt.table.cjkWidth.enum.0: Two columns (the usual case for a monospaced font).
fuxiFmt.table.cjkWidth.enum.1: One column (a proportional font, or one whose CJK glyphs are not double width).
fuxiFmt.thematicBreak.description: Which character a thematic break is written with. Every break becomes exactly three of it (BLK-13).
fuxiFmt.thematicBreak.enum.3: Keep the character and the run length as written.
fuxiFmt.typography.emphasis.strong.descr: Which delimiter bold is written with (TYPO-12).
fuxiFmt.typography.emphasis.em.descripti: Which delimiter italics is written with (TYPO-12).
fuxiFmt.typography.emphasis.strikethroug: One tilde or two (TYPO-12). A renderer that understands only one of them reads the other as literal tildes, so the default leaves it alone.
fuxiFmt.typography.cjkSpacing.descriptio: Insert one space at every CJK to non-CJK boundary (TYPO-01).
fuxiFmt.typography.punctuationStyle.enum: Convert toward whichever the surrounding script uses.
fuxiFmt.typography.punctuationChangeList: Half-width marks eligible for conversion; each entry is a single character (TYPO-05).
fuxiFmt.typography.halfwidthAlphanumeric: Full-width letters and digits become half-width (TYPO-06).
fuxiFmt.typography.hashtag.description: Space a mid-text `#` from CJK. Off by default, because `#` is usually a hashtag or an anchor (TYPO-09).
fuxiFmt.typography.parenStyle.descriptio: Parenthesis width, decided by the context typography.context selects (TYPO-08).
fuxiFmt.typography.cjkClasses.descriptio: Which scripts count as CJK. Defaults to Han alone.
fuxiFmt.typography.spacingSymbols.descri: Symbols that CJK spacing treats as word characters (TYPO-01).
fuxiFmt.typography.context.description: How Chinese context is decided for width rules (TYPO-05, TYPO-08).
fuxiFmt.typography.context.enum.0: The whole line decides, so a Chinese sentence quoting an English term gets Chinese punctuation.
fuxiFmt.typography.context.enum.1: Only the nearest significant character on either side of the mark decides.
fuxiFmt.typography.quotes.description: Convert straight double quotes to paired Chinese quotation marks (TYPO-11).
fuxiFmt.typography.quotes.enum.0: Convert them, when the quotation is in Chinese context.
fuxiFmt.typography.quotes.enum.1: Leave every quote exactly as written.
fuxiFmt.list.orderedStyle.enum.0: Number sequentially from the declared start.
fuxiFmt.list.orderedStyle.enum.1: The same, but leave an all-ones list as the author wrote it.
fuxiFmt.list.orderedDelimiter.descriptio: Marker delimiter for ordered lists: keep it, or force `.` or `)`.
fuxiFmt.list.orderedIndent.description: How far a nested ordered list item is indented (BLK-08).
fuxiFmt.list.unorderedIndent.description: How far a nested unordered list item is indented (BLK-08).
fuxiFmt.codeBlock.fenceLength.descriptio: Make a fence as long as its contents require (BLK-10).
fuxiFmt.codeBlock.trimBlankLines.descrip: Remove blank lines at the start and end of a code block, keeping the ones inside it (BLK-12).
fuxiFmt.diagnostics.unmatchedBacktick.de: Warn about a backtick that no code span closes, so it stays literal text (DET-06).
Warn about a dollar sign that no math span closes. A price and an unclosed formula look the same to the scanner (DET-07).
fuxiFmt.diagnostics.unclosedWikilink.des: Warn about [[ with no ]] on the same line (DET-08).
fuxiFmt.diagnostics.unclosedLinkDestinat: Warn about a link destination whose opening parenthesis is never closed (DET-09).
fuxiFmt.diagnostics.raggedTableRow.descr: Warn about a table row whose cell count differs from its header (DET-10).
fuxiFmt.diagnostics.listIndentJump.descr: Warn about a list item indented as if nested that belongs to no parent; its indentation is otherwise repaired silently (DET-11).
fuxiFmt.diagnostics.excludedList.descrip: Warn that a list containing a code block was left un-reindented (DET-12).
fuxiFmt.diagnostics.tableMaxWidth.descri: Say which rows `table.maxWidth` left out of the column widths, and which table the cap could not narrow at all (TBL-01).
fuxiFmt.endOfLine.description: Line ending to write. `auto` keeps whatever the file already used (BLK-11).
fuxiFmt.ignore.file.description: Comment text that makes the formatter skip a whole document (CFG-03).
fuxiFmt.ignore.start.description: Comment text that opens a range the formatter leaves alone (CFG-03).
fuxiFmt.ignore.end.description: Comment text that closes such a range (CFG-03).
fuxiFmt.ignore.line.description: Comment text that makes the formatter skip the next block (CFG-03).
extension.description: Format Markdown for Chinese technical writing: blank lines, marker spacing, list renumbering, CJK to Latin spacing and Chinese punctuation width - with code, front matter and inline spans never touched.
fuxiFmt.endOfLine.enum.2: Keep whatever the file already uses.
